prose: NBC News, citing CrowdStrike, reports that Chinese state-linked hackers used AI tools - including the popular DeepSeek model and another model, via a tool called ARTEX - to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations worldwide in just 11 days, compromising at least nine. CrowdStrike frames the campaign as an illustration of AI letting hackers operate at a scale that previously required far more human effort.
highlights: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers hit 200+ organizations in 11 days
AI tool ARTEX used a DeepSeek LLM and another model
AI as a force multiplier for state-linked intrusion scale
Basis: article lede plus Techmeme summary; the fetched page was mostly navigation content
basis: The fetched page contained the article's opening paragraphs followed by navigation content, so this entry is based on that lede and the Techmeme feed summary.
